summary: Iteration scope review for `welcome-email` succeeded. The current stories, elaborated requirements, and test design are consistent with the delivery objective: server-only Gmail welcome email configuration, new-user-only registration trigger, safe failure handling, duplicate avoidance, and mocked/injectable non-browser verification. Scope is correctly bounded away from dashboard, feedback upload/form, Configure, theme toggle, browser execution, deployment, and real Gmail delivery. Technical readiness is acceptable: prerequisite `registration-profile-consent` is present in source (`User.firstName`/`User.lastName`, registration actions, Google consent gate), `.env.local` contains the Gmail key names `GMAIL_USER`, `GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD`, and `GMAIL_FROM` without exposing values, and a feasible implementation path exists through server-only sender plus Auth.js/new-user creation handling. Checks run: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0` passed; `npx.cmd prisma validate` passed; `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false` passed. `npm.cmd ls nodemailer @types/nodemailer --depth=0` returned an empty dependency tree, which remains expected delivery work if Nodemailer is selected, not a scope blocker. Browser verification, Playwright, app server startup, deployment, publishing, and real Gmail delivery were not run per task constraints.
